rules.rule: PageSpec.template must be generationEligible in templates.json (template.legal is not: never captured).
PageSpec.route must be one of its template's routes; template.home is homeRouteOnly ('/').
Node (section,variant) sequence must equal the declared template's node list in order: every required node present, no extra or repeated nodes, no reordering.
All shell.* nodes precede every scroll-content node (fixed overlays mounted before the scroll story).
Exactly one hero.copy, and it is the first non-shell node, immediately followed by hero.video.
rules.exception: template.legal has no hero but is not generation-eligible, so the rule never runs against it.

rules.rule: deck.word-reveal-copy, deck.email-stack, deck.triage-game are contiguous and in that order (one sticky frame, one 3-step scroll float).
expand.compose-demo, expand.be-here-now, expand.search-demo, expand.notifications-demo are contiguous and in that order (one sticky frame, one integer state 0..6).
Final three nodes are footer.launch, proof.reviews-carousel, footer.bar (real DOM order inside <footer>); footer.bar is last.
shell.progress-dots content.stopCount equals the template's scrollStops length (13).
shell.scroll-hint hiddenOnStops must all be stop ids of the template.
Each node's motion pattern/trigger/reducedMotionFallback equals its section contract's motion.
Every budgeted text field obeys its section contract's fieldBudgets maxWords.
assetRef must be in the role's allowedRefs; generate-new-allowed roles carry no assetRef; sender-photo avatars must be bound to the card's sender.
Warn if more than 3 nodes carry video asset roles (the measured page has exactly 3: hero.video, expand.compose-demo, expand.be-here-now).
Warn if deck.email-stack has fewer than 4 cards: the source shows 2 swiped cards plus a visible stack behind them.

notEnforced.reason: Deliberately not applied: on this site same-category adjacency is the structure itself (SHELL x4, DECK x3, EXPAND x4 share one sticky frame each). Enforcing it would reject the only real page.
